# Saffron of Kashmir

> Premium Kashmiri Mongra saffron, harvested in Pampore, Kashmir.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saffronofkashmir.com/): Products, ordering information, FAQ, and the brand story.
- [Products](https://saffronofkashmir.com/products): Full product catalogue. In stock: Royal Mongra 2g, Collector's Tin 5g and Heritage Reserve 10g. Out of stock: Kashmiri Kahwa Blend 100g. Coming soon: Saffron Honey 500ml and Saffron Oil 15ml.
- [Recipes](https://saffronofkashmir.com/recipes): Tested saffron recipes: Kashmiri Kahwa, Zafrani Pulao, Kesar Doodh and Arabic Saffron Machboos.
- [Blog](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blogs): Index of every article below.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://saffronofkashmir.com/terms): Terms of sale for Saffron of Kashmir: how orders are made, prices, liability and governing law.
- [Shipping Policy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/shipping-policy): Where we ship, transit times, shipping charges, and who pays customs duties on international orders.
- [Returns Policy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/returns-policy): Returns for unopened tins within 7 days, replacements for parcels lost or damaged in transit, and what is not a defect.
- [Privacy Policy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/privacy-policy): What personal data we collect, who processes it, how long we keep it, and your rights under the DPDP Act 2023.
- [Accessibility](https://saffronofkashmir.com/accessibility): What this site does to be usable by everyone, what it has not been checked for, and how to tell us when something is in your way.

## Articles

- [How to Test Saffron Purity at Home](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/purity-tests/): The water test everyone repeats online passes some adulterated samples. What actually gets sold in place of saffron, and what each home test can and cannot see.
- [Kashmir Saffron GI No. 635: What It Actually Means](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/gi-635/): Kashmir Saffron holds Geographical Indication No. 635. What the tag legally does, who owns it, and what a buyer can actually check.
- [Why Most "Kashmiri Saffron" Sold Online Is Not From Kashmir](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/arithmetic-of-origin/): Kashmir grows saffron on about 3,665 hectares. Do the arithmetic on what is sold as Kashmiri and the numbers stop working.
- [Mongra Grade Saffron, and What the Other Names Mean](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/grade-names/): Two different grading systems are in use, one traditional and one laboratory. Sellers mix them. Here is what each name actually means.
- [Why We Do Not Make Health Claims](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/health-claims/): Two regulators prohibit a food seller from advertising a food as acting on a disease. Here is what they say, and what we say instead.
- [Kashmiri, Iranian and Spanish Saffron: What Origin Actually Tells You](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/origins-compared/): Origin is a weak predictor of quality and a strong predictor of price, vocabulary and supply chain. What the comparison survives, and what it does not.
- [Saffron Powder vs Threads: What You Can Actually Check](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/powder-or-threads/): Powder is not inferior saffron. It is unverifiable saffron. What you give up, where powder is genuinely better, and why grinding your own gets both.
- [How to Store Saffron So It Is Still Worth What You Paid](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/storing-saffron/): Saffron does not spoil, it fades. Light, heat, air and moisture in order of damage, and why the fridge is usually the wrong answer.
- [How Much Saffron to Actually Use](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/how-much-to-use/): Most recipes over-specify saffron by a factor of two or more, and over-steeping makes it bitter rather than stronger.
- [The Saffron Fields of Pampore: A Centuries-Old Legacy](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/pampore-legacy/): Saffron has grown at Pampore since at least the 14th century. The Karewa soil is why, and the growing area has been shrinking since the late 1990s.
- [Nobody Agrees How Much Saffron Kashmir Produces](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/production-figures/): Four official-sounding sources give four different production figures for the same years. One says 19.58 tonnes. Another says 2.6.
- [How to Read a Saffron Lab Report](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/read-lab-report/): ISO 3632 Category I tells you a batch passed. The crocin, picrocrocin and safranal numbers tell you by how much. How to read them.
- [What Saffron Should Cost in 2026](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/what-saffron-costs/): 160 to 180 flowers make one gram, all picked by hand. That fact sets a price floor no seller can go under honestly.
- [Using Kashmiri Saffron in Arabic Cuisine](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blog/arabic-cuisine/): Saffron has long been part of Arab cuisine - from celebratory Machboos to saffron-scented Gahwa and the delicate Umm Ali dessert.
